s: Lossless memakai Hot ImageBitmap + PNG lossless. Klasik menyimpan ImageBitmap mentah dengan CPU paling ringan. Video HW memakai WebCodecs prefer-hardware untuk kompresi preview berkualitas tinggi: RAM jauh lebih hemat tanpa biaya PNG yang berat; ekspor tidak terpengaruh. ⚠️ Kompatibilitas Video HW bergantung pada browser, SoC, dan driver codec; prefer-hardware tidak menjamin encoder hardware benar-benar dipakai. Jika jalur video tidak didukung atau gagal, Open Motion akan fallback ke Cache Klasik.
en: Lossless keeps hot frames as ImageBitmap + lossless PNG. Classic stores raw ImageBitmap with the lightest CPU cost. Video HW uses WebCodecs prefer-hardware for high-quality preview compression: far less RAM without the heavy PNG cost, and export is unaffected. ⚠️ Video HW compatibility depends on the browser, SoC and codec driver; prefer-hardware does not guarantee that a hardware encoder is actually used. If the video path is unsupported or fails, EditorsHub falls back to the Classic Cache.

s: Normal menjaga real-time dan boleh melewatkan cache jika decoder tertinggal. Real-time Mengejar juga menjaga playhead/audio real-time, tetapi pre-render mempertahankan antrean frame berurutan di belakang playhead dan mengejar tanpa sengaja membuat celah. Semi Kuat memberi frame yang hilang waktu singkat untuk masuk cache sehingga playback boleh sedikit melambat. Kuat menunggu setiap frame. Tombol Rekam Pre-render tetap memaksa Mode Kuat selama aktif.
en: Normal keeps real time and may skip the cache if the decoder falls behind. Realtime Catch-Up also keeps the playhead/audio real-time, but pre-render keeps a sequential frame queue behind the playhead and catches up without intentionally leaving gaps. Semi Strong gives missing frames a short window to enter the cache so playback may slow slightly. Strong waits for every frame. The Record Pre-render button still forces Strong mode while active.

s: Animator: simpan efek ini saja. Paket stack: simpan seluruh urutan efek native pada layer, beberapa animator, Text Style, efek pendukung, status aktif dan keyframe/easing. Tidak menyimpan isi teks, font, media, transform layer atau referensi luar. Efek AM impor/Expression layer/marker/matte/Particular belum portabel dan akan ditolak, bukan dihilangkan. Nama sama memperbarui preset; waktu keyframe relatif terhadap durasi layer tujuan.
en: Animator: saves just this effect. Stack package: saves the whole native effect order on the layer, several animators, Text Style, supporting effects, enabled state and keyframes/easing. It does not save text content, fonts, media, layer transforms or external references. Imported AM effects/layer Expressions/markers/mattes/Particular are not portable yet and are rejected rather than dropped. The same name updates a preset; keyframe times are relative to the destination layer duration.

s: Kompatibilitas AE bertahap: if/else, fungsi, loop terbatas, marker, key(), nearestKey(), valueAtTime(), loopIn/Out, ease dan seedRandom didukung. Wiggle memakai noise deterministik Open Motion, belum identik numerik dengan Adobe. DOM, jaringan, eval, prototype, async, class dan destructuring tidak tersedia. Batas 16384 operasi per evaluasi; kegagalan kembali ke keyframe asli dan dicatat di diagnostik Render.
en: Gradual AE compatibility: if/else, functions, limited loops, markers, key(), nearestKey(), valueAtTime(), loopIn/Out, ease and seedRandom are supported. Wiggle uses EditorsHub deterministic noise and is not yet numerically identical to Adobe. DOM, network, eval, prototypes, async, classes and destructuring are unavailable. The limit is 16384 operations per evaluation; failures fall back to the original keyframes and are logged in the Render diagnostics.

s: Satu shot tanpa cut. Blur kuat, area polos, objek bergerak dominan dan distorsi lensa dapat membuat solve gagal. Koreksi distorsi lensa belum disertakan. Analisis tidak berjalan saat playback; hasil tersimpan bersama proyek. Titik baru ditambahkan otomatis saat ada ruang kosong; titik yang benar-benar tertutup tidak dipalsukan. Kepadatan tinggi meningkatkan waktu analisis. Batas
en: A single shot with no cuts. Heavy blur, flat areas, dominant moving objects and lens distortion can make the solve fail. Lens distortion correction is not included yet. Analysis does not run during playback; results are stored with the project. New points are added automatically when space is free; fully occluded points are not faked. High density increases analysis time. Limit

s: Pre-render Timeline nonaktif secara default agar preview live mendapat prioritas penuh. Jika diaktifkan manual, pilihan disimpan di perangkat. Pada mobile/touch, Mode Normal dan Real-time Mengejar tidak menjalankan decoder pre-render kedua selama Play; Semi Kuat, Kuat, dan Rekam tetap tersedia sebagai mode eksplisit. Garis hijau menunjukkan frame yang benar-benar masih tersedia.
en: Timeline pre-render is off by default so the live preview gets full priority. If enabled manually, the choice is stored on the device. On mobile/touch, Normal mode and Realtime Catch-Up do not start a second pre-render decoder during Play; Semi Strong, Strong and Record stay available as explicit modes. The green line shows frames that are genuinely still available.

s: Aktifkan Ekspresi per target dan pilih hasil di parameter. textIndex/textTotal mengikuti target (1-based); wordIndex/lineIndex mengikuti layout. time = waktu komposisi, localTime = waktu preset. Gunakan Math.sin, Math.cos, random(), clamp(), linear(). Vektor XYZ: [x,y,z]; scale: [x,y]; opacity/amount: satu angka. Bukan JavaScript browser atau seluruh API After Effects.
en: Enable the per-target Expression and choose the result in the parameter. textIndex/textTotal follow the target (1-based); wordIndex/lineIndex follow the layout. time = composition time, localTime = preset time. Use Math.sin, Math.cos, random(), clamp(), linear(). XYZ vectors: [x,y,z]; scale: [x,y]; opacity/amount: a single number. This is not browser JavaScript or the full After Effects API.

s: Posisi menerima [x,y] pada layer 2D atau [x,y,z]; layer 3D wajib [x,y,z]. Scale/skew [x,y]. Tersedia linear, ease, clamp, random, Math, thisComp, thisLayer, keyframe, marker dan referensi controller. Random Seed membuat hasil konsisten pada waktu yang sama. Color Control menyediakan RGBA 0–1 sebagai data rumus, bukan efek fill.
en: Position accepts [x,y] on a 2D layer or [x,y,z]; 3D layers require [x,y,z]. Scale/skew [x,y]. linear, ease, clamp, random, Math, thisComp, thisLayer, keyframes, markers and controller references are available. Random Seed keeps results consistent at the same time. Color Control provides RGBA 0–1 as formula data, not a fill effect.

s: Secara sederhana, Opus menyediakan fondasi untuk membuat aplikasi yang berhubungan dengan video dan motion graphics. Framework ini dirancang untuk menangani video, audio, gambar, teks, compositing, animasi, efek visual, timeline multimedia, preview, rendering, export, serta berbagai kebutuhan media lainnya.
en: In short, the engine provides the foundation for building video and motion graphics apps. It is designed to handle video, audio, images, text, compositing, animation, visual effects, multimedia timelines, preview, rendering, export and other media needs.

s: Preset bawaan membuat keyframe Waktu preset. Edit nilai, waktu dan easing melalui ruler/diamond native; 0% awal, 100% akhir. Animasi kontinu bergerak sepanjang layer, dapat dipercepat, ditahan atau dibalik melalui keyframe Waktu preset. 3D memakai kartu datar XYZ dengan perspektif, bukan extrusion.
en: The built-in presets create a preset Time keyframe. Edit values, timing and easing with the native ruler/diamond; 0% is the start, 100% the end. Continuous animations move across the layer and can be sped up, held or reversed with the preset Time keyframe. 3D uses flat XYZ cards with perspective, not extrusion.

s: Kualitas KLT memakai rata-rata error maju–mundur dan residual patch yang diukur saat analisis; skor warna adalah indikator relatif, bukan peluang pasti benar. Data lama diberi estimasi dari kesinambungan dan jumlah sampel. Error solve kamera 3D tidak dipakai untuk menilai titik objek bergerak.
en: KLT quality uses the mean forward–backward error and patch residual measured during analysis; the colour score is a relative indicator, not a guaranteed probability of being correct. Legacy data is estimated from continuity and sample count. 3D camera solve error is not used to score moving object points.

s: Pilih satu tanda + saat pause. Keyframe X/Y bisa diedit melalui Transform atau Keyframes; parent-kan teks/shape ke Null untuk mengikuti gerakannya. Durasi Null hanya sepanjang lintasan tersambung. Keyframe adalah salinan posisi saat dibuat; perubahan transform video sesudahnya perlu Null baru.
en: Pick a single + mark while paused. X/Y keyframes can be edited through Transform or Keyframes; parent text/shape to the Null to follow its motion. The Null only lasts as long as the connected track. Keyframes are copies of the position when created; later video transform changes need a new Null.

s: Pilih satu tanda + saat pause. Null 3D mengikuti bidang footage, termasuk rotasi, posisi Z, parent dan perspektif kamera. Parent-kan teks/shape ke Null ini; Ruang 3D diwarisi otomatis. Keyframe X/Y bisa diedit melalui Transform atau Keyframes. Durasi Null hanya sepanjang lintasan tersambung.
en: Pick a single + mark while paused. A 3D Null follows the footage plane, including rotation, Z position, parent and camera perspective. Parent text/shape to this Null; 3D Space is inherited automatically. X/Y keyframes can be edited through Transform or Keyframes. The Null only lasts as long as the connected track.

s: Target: huruf, kata, baris, atau seluruh teks. Preset 3D adalah kartu teks datar dengan perspektif, bukan extrude. Range Selector setiap Text Animator independen. Parameter numerik memakai ruler/diamond dan easing native; gabungkan beberapa animator lalu simpan preset kustom.
en: Target: letter, word, line or the whole text. 3D presets are flat text cards with perspective, not extrusion. Each Text Animator's Range Selector is independent. Numeric parameters use the native ruler/diamond and easing; combine several animators then save a custom preset.

s: AI portrait/manusia, diproses lokal. Model 25,9 MB + runtime diunduh saat Proses ditekan; runtime perlu internet/cache browser. Video memakai interpolasi mask 6/12 sampel/detik, bukan AI realtime. Mask diproses sebelum semua efek piksel/geometri. Audio asli tetap ada.
en: AI portrait/human, processed locally. The 25.9 MB model + runtime download when Process is pressed; the runtime needs internet/browser cache. Video uses mask interpolation at 6/12 samples per second, not realtime AI. The mask is processed before all pixel/geometry effects. The original audio is kept.

s: Aktif secara default dengan intensitas 100%. Cahaya memakai lapisan latar terpisah; sampling mengikuti frame baru dan berkurang saat playback berat. Intensitas 0% menghentikan sampling. Efek hanya pada UI editor, bukan hasil ekspor. Pilihan disimpan di perangkat.
en: On by default at 100% intensity. Lighting uses a separate backdrop layer; sampling follows new frames and drops during heavy playback. 0% intensity stops sampling. The effect only appears in the editor UI, never in the export. The choice is stored on the device.

s: Urutan kartu efek piksel menentukan pemrosesan piksel. Kontrol Expression mengevaluasi transform setelah keyframe, tanpa pass shader. Particular dan Transform Motion Blur berada pada tahap komposisi akhir. Efek yang belum tersedia tetap disimpan saat diimpor.
en: The order of the pixel effect cards determines pixel processing. The Expression control evaluates the transform after keyframes, with no shader pass. Particular and Transform Motion Blur sit at the final compositing stage. Effects that are not available yet are still kept when imported.

s: Null 2D merekam proyeksi kamera utama, bukan Editor Camera. Setelah kamera/transform video berubah, buat Null 2D baru. Null 3D tetap mengikuti perubahan transform bidang video. Kedalaman objek di dalam rekaman tidak direkonstruksi oleh Null bidang video.
en: A 2D Null records the main camera projection, not the Editor Camera. After the camera/video transform changes, create a new 2D Null. A 3D Null keeps following changes to the video plane transform. Depth of objects inside the footage is not reconstructed by a video-plane Null.

s: Opus berbasis Kotlin Multiplatform dan dirancang untuk digunakan di beberapa platform. Pada materi pengembangnya, iPhone, iPad, dan macOS sudah didukung, sementara Android dan Windows masih dalam pengembangan. Dukungan Web dan backend juga direncanakan.
en: The engine is built on Kotlin Multiplatform and is designed to run on multiple platforms. Its developer material already covers iPhone, iPad and macOS, while Android and Windows are still in development. Web and backend support are planned.

s: Secara ringkas, Opus menyediakan asas untuk membina aplikasi video dan motion graphics. Ia direka untuk mengendalikan video, audio, imej, teks, compositing, animasi, kesan visual, timeline multimedia, preview, rendering, export dan keperluan media lain.
en: In short, the engine provides the foundation for building video and motion graphics apps. It is designed to handle video, audio, images, text, compositing, animation, visual effects, multimedia timelines, preview, rendering, export and other media needs.

s: Ho maneira simples, Opus fó fundasaun atu harii aplikasaun video no motion graphics. Nia dezenhu atu trata video, audio, imajen, testu, compositing, animation, visual effects, multimedia timeline, preview, rendering, export no nesesidade media seluk.
en: In short, the engine provides the foundation for building video and motion graphics apps. It is designed to handle video, audio, images, text, compositing, animation, visual effects, multimedia timelines, preview, rendering, export and other media needs.

s: Laporan JSON disimpan lokal, tidak dikirim ke server. URL dan email disamarkan; periksa nama layer/proyek dalam log sebelum membagikan. UJI RAM hanya mengaktifkan kategori diagnostik, tidak mengubah pre-render, kualitas preview, media atau cache.
en: The JSON report is stored locally and never sent to a server. URLs and emails are masked; check layer/project names in the log before sharing. TEST RAM only enables diagnostic categories and does not change pre-render, preview quality, media or the cache.

s: Adaptive N-Source mempertahankan sebanyak mungkin video pada decoder native. Saat beban melewati kapasitas terukur, Open Motion menurunkan cadence upload texture layer berprioritas rendah secara progresif sebelum memakai fallback WebCodecs.
en: Adaptive N-Source keeps as many videos as possible on the native decoder. When load exceeds measured capacity, EditorsHub progressively lowers the texture upload cadence of low-priority layers before using the WebCodecs fallback.

s: Hasil menjadi keyframe yang dapat diedit. Penerapan mengganti keyframe properti terkait hanya pada rentang analisis. Frame hilang tidak dibuatkan keyframe; interpolasi antarframe valid tetap berjalan. Tidak melacak saat playback.
en: The result becomes editable keyframes. Applying replaces the keyframes of the related property only within the analysis range. Missing frames get no keyframes; interpolation between valid frames still runs. Nothing is tracked during playback.

s: Tanpa marker tidak ada gerak. Flash/Blur membuat efek tambahan dengan keyframe biasa; setelah marker diubah, buat ulang lalu hapus hasil lama jika tidak diperlukan. Beat Motion diproses sebelum Expression, tanpa shader tambahan.
en: Without markers there is no motion. Flash/Blur creates extra effects with ordinary keyframes; after changing markers, regenerate and remove the old result if it is no longer needed. Beat Motion is processed before Expressions, with no extra shader.

s: Opus berasaskan Kotlin Multiplatform dan direka untuk beberapa platform. Dalam bahan pembangunnya, iPhone, iPad dan macOS sudah disokong, manakala Android dan Windows masih dibangunkan. Sokongan Web dan backend juga dirancang.
en: The engine is built on Kotlin Multiplatform and is designed to run on multiple platforms. Its developer material already covers iPhone, iPad and macOS, while Android and Windows are still in development. Web and backend support are planned.

s: Umur memakai satu segmen yang tersambung, bukan gabungan titik sebelum/sesudah hilang. Awal–akhir layer harus mencakup awal dan frame akhir layer (toleransi akhir satu frame proyek), bukan hanya rentang analisis pendek.
en: Age uses one connected segment, not points combined across a disappearance. The layer start–end must cover the layer start and last frame (one project frame tolerance at the end), not just a short analysis range.

s: Mode Otomatis hanya dapat memeriksa salinan yang pernah disimpan Open Motion di data proyek atau penyimpanan browser. Browser tidak dapat menelusuri seluruh penyimpanan perangkat tanpa pilihan file dari pengguna.
en: Automatic mode can only check copies that EditorsHub already stored in project data or browser storage. A browser cannot scan the whole device storage without the user picking a file.

s: Kamera solve lama tidak diterapkan ke footage yang sudah berada di Ruang 3D agar transform kamera tidak terhitung dua kali. Gunakan Null bidang video di sini; opsi kamera solve tersedia pada footage 2D.
en: The legacy camera solve is not applied to footage that is already in 3D Space, so the camera transform is not applied twice. Use a video-plane Null here; camera solve options are available on 2D footage.

s: Tahap 1 memakai satu layout engine untuk preview Canvas, WebGL texture, dan ekspor. Google Fonts dimuat hanya saat family dipakai; bila jaringan tidak tersedia, browser memakai fallback font sementara.
en: Stage 1 uses a single layout engine for the Canvas preview, WebGL textures and export. Google Fonts load only when a family is used; if the network is unavailable the browser falls back to a temporary font.

s: Opus bazeia ba Kotlin Multiplatform no dezenha ba platform barak. Iha materiál desenvolvedór, iPhone, iPad no macOS suporta ona, Android no Windows sei dezenvolve hela. Web no backend mos planeadu.
en: The engine is built on Kotlin Multiplatform and is designed to run on multiple platforms. Its developer material already covers iPhone, iPad and macOS, while Android and Windows are still in development. Web and backend support are planned.

s: Kalau Opus nantinya memang cocok, Open Motion tidak perlu membangun seluruh engine multimedia dari nol. Pengembangan bisa lebih fokus pada bagian yang benar-benar membentuk identitas Open Motion:
en: If Opus really is a good fit, EditorsHub will not have to build the entire multimedia engine from nothing. Development can concentrate on what makes EditorsHub itself:

s: Mode virtual non-fisik. FOV mengatur framing, Focal Length mengatur compression/expansion depth di sekitar Focus, dan Zoom melakukan crop canvas. Ketiganya independen dan dapat diberi keyframe.
en: A non-physical virtual mode. FOV controls framing, Focal Length controls depth compression/expansion around Focus, and Zoom crops the canvas. All three are independent and can be keyframed.

s: Lacak fitur dari video asli, baik footage 2D maupun footage di Ruang 3D. Pilih tanda + untuk membuat Null dengan keyframe yang bisa diedit. Titik pada footage 3D mengikuti perspektif kamera.
en: Track features from the original video, whether 2D footage or footage in 3D Space. Pick a + mark to create a Null with editable keyframes. Points on 3D footage follow the camera perspective.

s: Layer gambar, video, teks, dan shape yang nonaktif tetap dirender sebagai komposit 2D dan tidak dipengaruhi kamera. Saat diaktifkan, layer menjadi textured plane 3D dengan depth test WebGL.
en: Disabled image, video, text and shape layers are still rendered as 2D composites and are not affected by the camera. When enabled, the layer becomes a textured 3D plane with a WebGL depth test.

s: Point: satu detail. Two Points: posisi, rotasi dan scale. Planar: area bertekstur. Corner Pin: empat detail. Untuk empat titik pilih kiri atas → kanan atas → kanan bawah → kiri bawah.
en: Point: one detail. Two Points: position, rotation and scale. Planar: a textured area. Corner Pin: four details. For four points pick top left → top right → bottom right → bottom left.

s: Diagnostik modular untuk Timeline, Playback, Video, Audio, Render, Export, GPU Fast, Cache, Memory, dan UI. Semua nonaktif secara default; aktifkan hanya kategori yang sedang diuji.
en: Modular diagnostics for Timeline, Playback, Video, Audio, Render, Export, GPU Fast, Cache, Memory and UI. All are off by default; enable only the category you are testing.

s: Default: ganti animator terpilih/paket sebelumnya, efek lain tetap. Mode Ganti seluruh stack hanya untuk paket; teks, font dan transform layer tidak diganti. Undo tersedia.
en: Default: replaces the selected animator/previous package, other effects stay. Replace whole stack only applies to packages; text, fonts and layer transforms are not replaced. Undo is available.

s: Setelah framework-nya benar-benar dirilis, baru bisa dilihat apakah performa, fitur, kompatibilitas, lisensi, dan arah pengembangannya cocok dengan kebutuhan Open Motion.
en: Once the framework is actually released, we can judge whether its performance, features, compatibility, licensing and development direction fit the needs of EditorsHub.

s: Axis yang tidak dicentang dibekukan pada nilai saat ikatan diterapkan. Rotasi mengikuti perubahan relatif target dari titik ikat sehingga tidak meloncat saat diaktifkan.
en: Unchecked axes are frozen at their value when the binding is applied. Rotation follows the target's relative change from the binding point, so nothing jumps when it is enabled.

s: Kualitas preview hanya memengaruhi editor. Ekspor tetap memakai kualitas penuh. Scrub video memakai WebCodecs bila tersedia dan fallback otomatis jika tidak didukung.
en: Preview quality only affects the editor. Export still uses full quality. Video scrubbing uses WebCodecs when available and falls back automatically when it is not supported.

s: Untuk sekarang, Open Motion dikembangkan sebagai aplikasi berbasis web karena lebih cepat untuk melakukan eksperimen, mencoba fitur baru, dan mengubah sistem editor.
en: For now, EditorsHub is built as a web-based app because that makes it faster to experiment, try new features and change the editor system.

s: Jika Opus benar-benar sesuai, Open Motion tidak perlu membina keseluruhan enjin multimedia dari kosong. Pembangunan boleh lebih tertumpu pada identiti Open Motion:
en: If Opus really is a good fit, EditorsHub will not have to build the entire multimedia engine from nothing. Development can concentrate on what makes EditorsHub itself:

s: Buat masa ini, Open Motion dibangunkan sebagai aplikasi berasaskan web kerana lebih cepat untuk bereksperimen, menguji ciri baharu dan mengubah sistem editor.
en: For now, EditorsHub is built as a web-based app because that makes it faster to experiment, test new features and change the editor system.

s: Selepas framework itu benar-benar dilancarkan, prestasi, ciri, keserasian, lesen dan hala tuju pembangunannya akan dinilai mengikut keperluan Open Motion.
en: Once that framework is actually released, its performance, features, compatibility, licence and development direction will be judged against the needs of EditorsHub.

s: Mengatur kekuatan warna ambient tanpa mengubah tampilan dasar UI. Piksel putih/abu terang otomatis diberi bobot lebih kecil agar tidak mendominasi ambient.
en: Controls the ambient colour strength without changing the base UI look. White/bright grey pixels are weighted down automatically so they do not dominate the ambient light.

s: Open Motion akan berkembang secara bertahap dengan fokus membangun editor motion graphics yang fleksibel, ringan, dan punya workflow yang nyaman digunakan.
en: EditorsHub grows step by step, focused on becoming a flexible, lightweight motion graphics editor with a comfortable workflow.

s: Open Motion akan berkembang secara berperingkat dengan fokus membina editor motion graphics yang fleksibel, ringan dan mempunyai aliran kerja yang selesa.
en: EditorsHub grows step by step, focused on becoming a flexible, lightweight motion graphics editor with a comfortable workflow.

s: untuk menangani timeline, decoding video/audio, playback, compositing, animasi, efek, filter, GPU rendering, export video, serta sistem 3D dan kamera.
en: to handle timelines, video/audio decoding, playback, compositing, animation, effects, filters, GPU rendering, video export, plus the 3D and camera systems.

s: Depois framework sai duni, foin bele avalia performance, funsaun, compatibility, lisensa no direksaun dezenvolvimentu tuir nesesidade Open Motion.
en: Once that framework is released, its performance, features, compatibility, licence and development direction will be judged against the needs of EditorsHub.

s: Hasil kamera lama tetap tersedia. Penempatan 3D membutuhkan titik + yang valid untuk solve; tanda + lain tetap dapat digunakan sebagai lintasan 2D.
en: The old camera result stays available. 3D placement needs valid + points to solve; other + marks can still be used as 2D tracks.

s: Se Opus duni apropriadu, Open Motion la presiza harii multimedia engine tomak husi zero. Dezenvolvimentu bele fokus liu ba identidade Open Motion:
en: If Opus really is a good fit, EditorsHub will not have to build the entire multimedia engine from nothing. Development can concentrate on what makes EditorsHub itself:

s: Tersimpan lokal di browser ini. Ekspor JSON sebagai cadangan. File v1 lama tetap dapat diimpor; paket gabungan memerlukan V5.227 atau lebih baru.
en: Stored locally in this browser. Export JSON as a backup. Legacy v1 files can still be imported; combined packages need V5.227 or newer.

s: Camera Motion Blur memakai temporal sampling Open Motion sendiri. Saat OFF, renderer kamera tetap memakai jalur V5.167 tanpa temporal sampling.
en: Camera Motion Blur uses EditorsHub's own temporal sampling. When OFF, the camera renderer keeps using the V5.167 path without temporal sampling.

s: Open Motion sei dezenvolve etapa ba etapa ho fokus atu harii editor motion graphics ne'ebé fleksível, kmaan no iha workflow ne'ebé komfortável.
en: EditorsHub grows step by step, focused on becoming a flexible, lightweight motion graphics editor with a comfortable workflow.

s: untuk timeline, decoding video/audio, playback, compositing, animasi, kesan, penapis, GPU rendering, export video serta sistem 3D dan kamera.
en: for timelines, video/audio decoding, playback, compositing, animation, effects, filters, GPU rendering, video export plus the 3D and camera systems.

s: Agora daudaun Open Motion dezenvolve hanesan aplikasaun web tanba fasil liu atu halo esperimentu, testa funsaun foun no muda sistema editor.
en: For now, EditorsHub is built as a web-based app because that makes it faster to experiment, test new features and change the editor system.

s: Lensa fisik tetap. Zoom memperbesar/crop seluruh canvas hasil kamera dari titik tengah; FOV, Focal Length, dan posisi kamera tidak berubah.
en: The physical lens stays fixed. Zoom enlarges/crops the whole camera result from the centre point; FOV, Focal Length and camera position do not change.

s: Satu slot mengganti semua layer dengan aset yang sama. Keyframe, efek, trim dan tata letak tetap dipertahankan. Pilih jenis file yang sama.
en: One slot replaces every layer that uses the same asset. Keyframes, effects, trims and layout are preserved. Pick the same file type.

s: ba timeline, video/audio decoding, playback, compositing, animation, effects, filters, GPU rendering, video export, sistema 3D no kamera.
en: for timelines, video/audio decoding, playback, compositing, animation, effects, filters, GPU rendering, video export, the 3D system and the camera.

s: yang sedang dikembangkan oleh The Prismatic Company, yang juga melibatkan pengembang yang sebelumnya pernah mengerjakan Alight Motion.
en: being developed by The Prismatic Company, which also involves developers who previously worked on Alight Motion.

s: , atualmente desenvolvido pela The Prismatic Company, que também envolve programadores que anteriormente trabalharam no Alight Motion.
en: being developed by The Prismatic Company, which also involves developers who previously worked on Alight Motion.
